summary: Iteration 6 validates the SMT Production new schema (planing_smt/act_smt_s{3,1,2}/plan_assy/act_assy_s{3,1,2} with computed cap_h, total_act_smt, achv, total_act_assy, balance, status), Stock SMT H-1 auto-linking, and the new Backup & Restore module. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_prod_stock_backup.py — (a) POST/PUT/DELETE /api/smt-production with the review payload yields cap_h=120, total_act_smt=900, achv=90.0, total_act_assy=700, balance=200, status=PROSES; PUT act_smt_s2=300 → total_act_smt=1000, achv=100, balance=300, status=SELESAI; (b) seed on 2026-09-22 is exactly 84 rows containing planing_smt/plan_assy; (c) /api/import/smt-production/template Excel header row matches TANGGAL|LANE|PRODUCT|TYPE|ICS NO|T/T|PLANING SMT|ACT SMT S3|ACT SMT S1|ACT SMT S2|PLAN ASSY|ACT ASSY S3|ACT ASSY S1|ACT ASSY S2 (CAP/H, TOTAL SMT, ACHV %, TOTAL ASSY, BALANCE are treated as __skip__); (d) preview+confirm of /app/backend/seed/smt_production.csv → duplicates=84 total=84, confirm inserted=0 updated=84, total document count remains 84; (e) dashboard summary kpi contains smt_total/smt_plan/plan_assy/assy_total/balance, smt_trend rows have plan/actual/plan_assy/actual_assy, smt_by_lane rows have act_smt_s3/s1/s2. Stock SMT: created 2026-09-14 (ok=100) auto-linked to 2026-09-13 giving stock_ok_prev=714 & stock_ok_prev_source='2026-09-13'; 2026-09-15 links to 2026-09-14 (100); 2026-09-17 falls back to 2026-09-15 (200); PUT 2026-09-15 with stock_ok_prev=55 & stock_ok_manual=true persists 55 without being overwritten by link_stock_prev; GET /api/prev-values?date=2026-09-14&ics_no=5298375400&type=RC%20K3VA returns {found:true, source_date:'2026-09-13', stock_ok_prev:714}. Backup: GET /api/backup/export returns application/zip containing exactly 9 files (smt_production/smt_stock/production_needs/variance/items/users/audit_log/notifications JSON + meta.json); preview of that zip returns 5 modules each in_backup==current; preview with .csv → 400 with detail containing '.zip'; restore returns ok=true with removed==restored per module and document counts of the 5 data modules are unchanged; GET /api/audit?action=RESTORE contains RESTORE logs for all 5 data modules; smt/password123 GET /api/backup/export → 403. Frontend (Playwright on public URL, https://data-stock-branch.preview.emergentagent.com): admin sees nav-backup, /backup renders backup-export-button → expect_download captured backup_cds_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.zip (49 KB); uploading that zip via restore-file-input shows restore-preview with 5 module rows; clicking restore-button → dialog → restore-confirm → restore-result visible with toast 'Restore selesai'. Produksi SMT & ASSY table headers include Planing SMT, Act SMT S3/S1/S2, Total Act SMT, Achv %, Plan Assy, Act Assy S3/S1/S2, Total Act Assy, Balance (uppercased via CSS but present in DOM). Tambah dialog exposes data-testid=field-planing_smt and field-act_assy_s3. Stock SMT → Tambah → date 2026-09-14 + ics 5298375400 + type 'RC K3VA' → prev-values-hint 'Nilai kemarin diambil dari Stock SMT 2026-09-13 (OK 714, Total 1347)…' shown in emerald, field-stock_ok_prev auto-populated with 714; record-cancel dismisses dialog cleanly. smt/password123 login: nav-backup hidden and direct /backup renders data-testid=no-access 'Anda tidak memiliki akses ke modul ini.'. No seed data was touched: 84 smt_production rows on 2026-09-22 remain intact after import & restore. All test-created stock rows (2026-09-14/15/17) and smt-production 8888888888 were deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1120 lines — still well over the 700-line guideline; split into modules (auth, crud, audit, notifications, import, dashboard, backup, seed) is overdue.

backup_restore() replaces users/audit_log/notifications collections only implicitly via RESTORE_COLLECTIONS = DATA_MODULES, which is correct per spec. Consider persisting a marker in meta.json (already present) and validating meta.app/version to reject foreign backups before wiping data.

backup_restore() deletes all rows before insert_many() — no transaction. If insert_many fails mid-way the module is left empty. Wrap in a Motor session/transaction or write a temporary staging collection then rename.

read_backup() rejects only extensions not ending in .zip. A .zip file with non-JSON contents falls back to a 400 via generic exception, but the error message leaks internals (json.decoder.JSONDecodeError). Consider a friendlier detail.
link_stock_prev() runs a per-doc find on every GET /api/smt-stock request → O(N) DB round-trips for large lists. Add compound index on (ics_no, type, date) and consider batching or projection.

header_map __skip__ contains 'total smt' and 'balance' but the CSV column is 'TOTAL ACT SMT' and 'BALANCE' — both are mapped to __skip__ correctly here, but 'CAP/H' matches literal 'cap/h' which is also correct. Good, but list-maintenance risk if new template columns appear.

compute_smt_production uses round() for cap_h (integer) but r1() elsewhere — Python round(120.0) → 120 is fine, but round(3600/29.02)=124 matches expected. Confirm all seed rows' cap_h derived from tt agree with the CSV CAP/H column (they should).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login, backup export/preview/restore, smt-production table+form, stock prev-link autoloading, smt user no-access guard)

seed_data_creation: None. Test row 8888888888 on 2026-09-23 for smt-production and 2026-09-14/15/17 stock rows for ics 5298375400 all deleted at end of tests. Seed of 84 smt-production rows on 2026-09-22 verified intact.
